Description:

Usage:

notes: The .NET SDK 8.0 is installed and callable. Network access to nuget.org may be restricted in the current environment, but the base image mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:8.0 will have full network access during image build. The setup_runtime.sh script will restore NuGet packages at build time. No activation command is needed since .NET SDK is a system-level install.
